core_obligations: Choose a presentation: take a smooth presentation of the stack by a scheme and use that the diagonal is etale to make the two projections of the presentation etale, together with the local Noetherianity and reducedness of the presentation (proof lines 4412-4430)

Residue field computation: the point is unique, so the fibre product of the residue field point with the presentation is a nonempty scheme whose diagonal is etale and hence an open immersion, which makes the comparison morphism to the presentation unramified at the relevant point (proof lines 4431-4448)

Produce the field: a closed point of an etale cover of the fibre gives a finite separable extension of the residue field whose local ring is that extension, so the residue field point itself becomes etale over the stack (proof lines 4449-4540)
Conclusion: the resulting morphism from the spectrum of the residue field to the stack is surjective because the space of the stack is a single point (proof lines 4541-4544)
proof_roadmap: 取 U → Z 的满光滑展示；DM ⇒ Δ 是 étale ⇒ 两支投影 étale；U 局部 Noetherian 且既约。
|Z| 单点 ⇒ 取剩余域点 Spec(k) → Z，F = U ×_Z Spec(k) 非空；由 F ×_U F 的两支 étale 得 Δ_{F/U} étale，从而（由 étale + 一致单射 ⇒ 开浸入）是开浸入 ⇒ F → U unramified。
取 V → F 的 étale 覆盖（V 非空仿射），取 k ⊂ κ(v) 有限可分的闭点 v；O_{V,v} 正则，φ(m_u)O_{V,v} = m_v，取 f_i 使像为 m_v/m_v² 的基 ⇒ 正则有序列；由 slice 引理缩 U 使 V(f_i) → Z 平坦局部有限表现。
V(f_i) ×_U V = V(f_i|_V) 是闭子概型 T ⊂ V 且 O_{T,v} = κ(v) ⇒ T → Spec(k) 在 v 处 unramified ⇒ 由 etale-at-point 得某开邻域上 V(f_i) → Z étale。
对每个有限型点取这样的 W_x → Z，令 W = ∐ W_x，f = ∐ f_x 满 étale ⇒ 得所求。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a DM, locally Noetherian, reduced algebraic stack whose space is a single point admits a surjective etale morphism from the spectrum of a field (author lemma at source lines 4405-4410, label lemma-DM-residual-gerbe). The proof (source lines 4412-4545) chooses a smooth presentation, makes its diagonal etale, deduces unramifiedness of the comparison morphism to the presentation, produces a finite separable residue field extension at a closed point of an etale cover, and concludes etaleness on an open neighbourhood by the slice lemma and the local criterion for etaleness (proof lines 4412-4544). The residue field computation and the slice argument are the substance. H3.
